basis: FEED-010 records PROGRAM/feedback as an untested mechanism proposal, not as an author-confirmed rule.
H016-v2 tested an external repeating key and F exception; this hypothesis uses no external key and no F exception, so it is a new mechanism family rather than an H016 parameter variation.
H008 tested adjacent equality as one structural statistic, but did not test the complete first-difference transform followed by an independent language-score gate.
hypothesis: LP2 encodes plaintext by first-order ciphertext feedback: for each page, C[-1]=0, P[0]=C[0], and P[i]=(C[i]-C[i-1]) mod29 for i>0; the transformed rune sequence should be measurably more text-like than its within-page permutation controls.
falsifiable_predictions: A verifier-only synthetic ciphertext formed by cumulative mod29 addition of an exact plaintext is recovered exactly by the worker, including a first-rune F, adjacent-equal ciphertext values, and a page boundary.

The fixed feedback transform applied to all 55 applicable LP2 pages yields at least one maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 unit under the frozen training-only unigram score if it produces an exploratory page lead; otherwise this exact feedback and score/null combination is negative only within its stated scope.

Changing one internal ciphertext value by delta changes only the corresponding difference by +delta and the following difference by -delta modulo29; a direct independent perturbation check must confirm this locality.

sources.role: Untested PROGRAM/feedback proposal and explicit method boundary.
Previously calibrated training-only unigram scorer; no new threshold tuning in this batch.
Pinned LP2 raw corpus and page applicability.
Verifier-only synthetic positive plaintext material; never passed to worker.

applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of mixed literal pages LP2/49 and LP2/51.

excluded_objects.reason: Pinned source has no registered rune tokens; its literal alphanumeric grid is outside this rune-domain feedback model and is unexecuted, not negative.

representation: Original rune ordinal indices 0..28 only; non-rune characters remain in the raw source and are not silently included in the feedback sequence.

transform.boundary: Reset C[-1]=0 at every applicable page; no row, paragraph, delimiter or chapter reset.
transform.f_policy: F is ordinary rune index 0 in this model; no copied-F exception or skip is added.
transform.literals: Non-rune characters do not enter the sequence and do not update the previous ciphertext.

algorithm_version: H017-v1: fixed page-reset first difference over ciphertext modulo29, first transformed rune retained for exact validation but omitted from score, training-only unigram score, no key search or language completion.

scoring.score: Mean log-smoothed unigram weight over decoded indices P[1:] only; weights are frozen from data/synthetic/training.txt with add-one smoothing and no LP2 data.
scoring.units: 55 page-reset LP2 units; one score per applicable page.
scoring.maxT: Standardize observed and 999 control score vectors together; compare each observed unit against the maximum control z across all 55 units with plus-one p and tie tolerance 1e-12.
scoring.lead: Complete controls and maxT-adjusted p<=0.01; this is an exploratory feedback lead, not a decryption acceptance.
scoring.negative: Complete controls, passed independent validation and no lead; scoped only to this exact feedback transform, scorer and within-page permutation null.

controls.random_null: For every applicable page, uniformly shuffle its complete ciphertext multiset within the page; preserve page length, rune multiset, page order and boundaries. Each replicate supplies one joint 55-unit score vector.
controls.synthetic_positive: Two verifier-only exact plaintexts include first-rune F, adjacent-equal ciphertext opportunities and ordinary boundary behavior; cumulative mod29 encryption is checked independently against the worker's difference output.
controls.negative_mutation: Independent verification must reject a changed decoded rune or changed page output; a local internal-ciphertext perturbation check is separate from the corpus statistic.
controls.independent: The worker computes the public difference transform; the orchestrator independently subtracts neighboring ciphertext values, recomputes every score and exact synthetic roundtrip, and checks coverage/order.

randomness.role: Page-permutation controls and private synthetic generation only; no key, plaintext or seed is passed to the worker. Partial controls are checkpointed with replay hashes.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes this specification, source/data hashes, public ciphertext jobs, private expected plaintexts, code snapshot, scorer weights and control seed before invoking the guarded worker or calculating corpus scores.
independent_validation_path: The worker receives only public jobs. The verifier uses a separate direct neighbor-subtraction implementation and direct cumulative encryptor; no output-selected rule or language completion is used.
timeout_policy: One 120-second monotonic deadline covers worker, observations, controls and statistics. Each completed control row is appended to partial JSONL; atomically replaced checkpoints record count, partial hash, frozen hash, seed, replay rule and RNG-state digest. Timeout is never negative.
uncovered_parameters: Other initial previous-cipher values, feedback orders and page/line reset policies
H016's repeating keys and plaintext-F exception, other keys, skip rules and feedback/autokey families
Multiplicative/PGL projections, geometry and literal grid participation
Independent LP2 plaintext and image-level glyph audit
next_step: If a score lead appears, freeze an independent predicted plaintext/page before interpretation. If no lead appears, do not tune the feedback order or initial value; switch to a new method family.
note: This is a deterministic feedback compatibility and measurement experiment, not an unconstrained differential search or decryption claim.
